SddAmplifyObservability.keywords: observability, amplify, logs, metrics, traces, alerts, slo, dashboards, sdd-amplify-observability
SddAmplifyObservability.Mission:
Make observability a set of design decisions in a scope spec under discovery — logs, metrics, traces, alerts — instead of an afterthought sprinkled at execution time. Loaded lazily by the discovery interview's triage when the scope has an operational runtime (service, worker, long-lived process); inherits the session core — not repeated here.
Input — the scope spec draft + interview context. Output — an `Observability` subsection inside Requirements & Constraints of the scope spec + follow-up items on the discovery interview map. Out of scope: dashboard layouts, vendor configuration — the spec records what is observed and why, tooling carries the how.

BeliefState.Axiom: An amplification opens with a ready answer, not a questionnaire. FIRST assemble a complete defaults package — the decisions live products of this class actually ship with (run a short targeted research pass when class practice is uncertain, grounded in the scope's intent) — and present it as ONE accept-or-edit reply: the operator takes everything with one word or edits by item number. Ask via the AskUserQuestion / multi-question tool when available; fallback `QUESTION_FORMAT`. Deep-dive questions open only for topics the operator explicitly marks deep-dive; every untouched topic keeps its default. An accepted default is a real decision — record it like one.

Every non-trivial decision → a Decision Log entry in `DECISION_LOG_ENTRY_FORMAT` (D-NNN, Status, Recorded, Why in the operator's wording, Risk accepted, Rejected alternatives; IDs are stable). Which decisions qualify and which Decision Log receives the entry are specified per directive.

Raw `console.*` is forbidden. Use the shared logger from `#logger`: `logger[level](message, detail?)`. Levels: `debug` / `info` / `warn` / `error`. One or two arguments: first is a string message, second (when needed) is a `detail` object. **NEVER serialize objects into the message string.** Pseudo-loggers (`const logger = console`) forbidden.
The shared logger is the only sink that can be re-targeted (transport, redaction, sampling) without editing call-sites; raw `console` breaks agent-readable structure.

Logs at entry points, important branches, external I/O / mutations, catch blocks. Loops logged in aggregate, NOT per iteration. In `catch`: ALWAYS `logger.error` with Trace-Prefix and context, then recover via `throw` or `return fail()` per `AX_CATCH_LOG_RECOVER`. Intent-driven density yields a readable story-line; per-iteration spam drowns real signals.

Alert on operator-visible symptoms — SLO burn, error rate, saturation, staleness — and page a human only for actionable conditions; cause-level signals stay on dashboards. Every alert names its threshold, its severity, and the first response action. An alert nobody acts on is noise debt: delete it or demote it.

SddAmplifyObservability.HaltConditions: | 🛑 ID | Trigger | |---|---| | `H_NO_RUNTIME_SURFACE` | Triage misfired: no operational runtime (pure library — observability belongs to the consumer) — report and return control | | `H_OPERATOR_REJECTS_DEFAULTS` | Operator declines the whole defaults package and skips deep-dive — leave the spec untouched |

Step.Goal: Assemble the observability defaults package for this product class.
Step.Action: From the spec draft, list the operational surfaces: entry points, external I/O, queues, long operations. No runtime surface → `H_NO_RUNTIME_SURFACE`. Per `AX_AMPLIFY_DEFAULTS_FIRST`, draft one default decision per signal: logs (structure + levels per `AX_STRUCTURED_LOGGING`, density per `AX_LOG_DENSITY`), metrics (RED for request paths / USE for resources — the minimal set answering «жив ли сервис и где болит»), traces (propagation boundaries + sampling), alerts (symptom → threshold → severity → first action, per `AX_ALERTS_ON_SYMPTOMS`) — grounded in what live products of this class ship; short targeted research when class practice is uncertain.

Step.Goal: One accept-or-edit gate; deep-dive only on explicit pick.
Step.Action: Present the package as ONE reply per `AX_AMPLIFY_DEFAULTS_FIRST` (AskUserQuestion when available, else `QUESTION_FORMAT`); each signal accept / edit / deep-dive. Deep-dive topic map: logs → metrics → traces → alerts → SLO linkage. Untouched signals keep their defaults. STOP.

Step.Goal: Write the agreed observability decisions into the spec.
Step.Action: Write an `### Observability` subsection into Requirements & Constraints of the scope spec: **Logs** (структура, уровни, транспорт) → **Metrics** (`| Метрика | Тип | Что отвечает |`) → **Traces** (границы propagation, sampling) → **Alerts** (`| Симптом | Порог | Severity | Первое действие |`). Non-default picks and notable accepted defaults → Decision Log per `AX_DECISION_LOG_REQUIRED`. Unresolved topics → items on the discovery interview map. Return control to the interview.

SddAmplifyObservability.ChatOutput: Service line — dim, internal, never narrated (`AX_NO_PROCESS_NARRATION`): `📡 AMP_OBS · signals= · accepted= · edited= · dive=`.
